cases.title: Exaggerate forward weight with a banked trail foot to learn the through-side feel
cases.coaching_finding: Uploader calls this compression training. Embedded excerpt begins after the problem explanation, so no specific initial golfer fault is established.
cases.coach_reasoning: Instructor says the preset creates forward-weight/banked-foot feel and teaches how it should translate into the through side. He also attributes a draw to this arrangement, without measurement.

procedure: Widen stance relative to normal setup.
Bank right/trail foot inward and pre-lengthen the right leg as demonstrated.
Feel weight forward and hit from the preset.
intervention.cue: Feel the forward-weight preset through the shot.
intervention.limits: These are steps of one exaggerated rehearsal, not a universal address recommendation. Source gives no foot angle, pressure percentage or required stance width.

applicability: A separately established need to learn the demonstrated through-side/forward-weight feel.
Golfer can comfortably use the preset and actual strike/flight response is useful.
unknowns: Original lesson source and complete speaker identification; hashtag alone does not identify the instructor.
Original diagnosis, golfer constraints, club number and prior ball flight.
Whether preset transfers to normal setup or consistently changes compression/shot shape.
cases.observed_result: One embedded instructor shot with verbal draw claim and source tracer; separate uploader shot montage. No measured before/after or long-term outcome.

selection.coaching_focus: Learn one through-side feel with a preset
selection.policy_origin: User preference: one focus and at most two compatible cues; setup procedure is a single task.
selection.reassess: Proposed app check: remove exaggerated preset, compare strike and ball flight, and check that the intended through-side motion carries over. Do not promise a draw.

limits: Universal draw prediction unsupported by single example.

limits: Not raw launch data or a matched comparison.

source_ambiguities.issue: ASR splits pre-lengthen into pre-length in. Embedded subtitle at21s reads pre-lengthen and visible right-leg setup supports the intended word.
Original instructor identity not verified from textual source. Search did not establish a primary original source; no name is inferred from appearance.
Universal draw claim is retained as instructor claim, not adopted as deterministic coaching logic.

cross_source_links.explanation: Allen’s trail-foot flare changes toe direction. This drill banks the foot inward with a lengthened trail leg; flare, setback and bank are not interchangeable tags.

Allen initially starts more weight right to reduce unstable movement before going left in downswing. This exaggerated drill starts forward to teach a through-side feel. Preserve task and phase rather than merge them into one setup rule.
Ruffels supplies an explicit no-aid target block. This excerpt explains transfer but does not show an ordinary-setup retest of the learner.

annotation_opportunities: Show normal setup beside the exaggerated preset with the source Exaggerate label.
